 HELPER --> GATE[\"Wait at start gate\"]

 CG -->|Release| GATE

 ROOT --> FORK[\"Fork into target PID namespace\"]
 FORK --> WAIT[\"Bootstrap forwards signals and waits\"]
 FORK --> TASK[\"Mapped UID 0 executes command\"]
 TASK -->|Exit status| WAIT
 WAIT -->|Exit status| CLI
